summary: This plugin adds `fffind` and `ffgrep` tools to DeepSeek Harness to perform workspace-scoped fuzzy path search and content grep-style matching, returning structured search matches for model tool calls.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Conservatively classified as a file tooling plugin: it exposes two workspace-aware search tools for model calls (`fffind` and `ffgrep`), backed by an indexed file-finder helper and optional web settings control. User-facing behavior is centered on filesystem lookup and match retrieval rather than editing, external integrations, or media handling, so it fits a files-and-terminal-style utility with a focused UI companion for search settings.
